note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). The object's change is shown only as a visual state (crack, chipped lip, dent, scratches); nothing is valued and no fault, liability, compensation or causation conclusion is drawn. Every record entry is as supplied.
